1) **Your email address**, or  
2) **First name + last name + ZIP code**

Once I verify your user profile, tell me the **order ID** (e.g., `#W0000000`) and which option you want:
- **Cancel pending order** (if it hasn’t shipped/processed), or
- **Return delivered order** (if it has already been delivered)

If you don’t know the status, just share the order ID and I’ll check it.

mia_garcia_4516

Error: Order not found

Sorry about that—**#W4598127** also isn’t showing up in the system for your account.

Could you try one of these so I can locate the right order?
1) Re-check the order ID spelling/number (it must match exactly, including the **#**), or  
2) Share the **approximate order date** (and time zone if you know it) and/or what you ordered (at least one item name), or  
3) If you have more than one similar-looking order, paste the other order ID(s) you’re unsure about.

Once I can find the order, I’ll tell you whether you can **cancel** (pending) or **return** (delivered), and for which items.
I placed the order about two weeks ago, probably around the 10th of this month. One of the items I remember ordering was a mechanical keyboard. Does that help narrow it down?
